# trajectoryBlendingTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [trajectoryBlendingTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/trajectoryBlendingTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The blending of the profiles of exudyn.robotics.motion.Trajectory (#3274): Trajectory.Add(profile,
#           blendTimeWithNext) lets the next profile start before the present one ends, the trajectory is the sum of
#           the motions of both. Three profiles of constant acceleration, the first two blended by the deceleration
#           time of the first: the trajectory ends earlier by the blend time at the same coordinates, its velocities are
#           the derivative of its coordinates, the velocity of an axis that moves on in the same direction stays
#           constant in the blending, Evaluate(t, enableBlending=False) and EvaluateCoordinate agree with the profiles
#           one after the other; GetBlendings gives the distances from the via point, also of the tool of the Staubli
#           TX2-90L; a Cartesian line blended with a joint motion; a blend time longer than a profile is refused. The
#           result is the number of checks that pass plus the distances of GetBlendings.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-05
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.robotics.models import ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L, LinkDict2Robot
from exudyn.robotics.motion import Trajectory, ProfileConstantAcceleration, ProfileCartesianLinear
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

checks = []
robot = LinkDict2Robot(ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L())
chain = robot.GetKinematicChain()
q0 = np.array([0, 0.5, 1.4, 0, 1.2, 0.])
q1 = q0 + [0.4, 0.2, -0.2, 0.1, 0, 0]
q2 = q1 + [0.4, -0.2, -0.1, 0.3, 0, 0]

def Profiles(blendTime):
    trajectory = Trajectory(q0, initialTime=0.)
    trajectory.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q1, 1.), blendTimeWithNext=blendTime)
    trajectory.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q2, 1.))
    trajectory.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q0, 1.))
    return trajectory

trajectory = Profiles(0.5) #the deceleration of the first and the acceleration of the second profile
unblended = Profiles(0.)
checks += [np.allclose(trajectory.GetTimes(), [0, 1, 1.5, 2.5]) and np.allclose(trajectory.GetTimes(enableBlending=False), [0, 1, 2, 3])]
times = np.linspace(0, 3, 3001)
[q, v] = [np.array([trajectory.Evaluate(t)[i] for t in times]) for i in [0, 1]]
checks += [np.max(np.abs(q[-1] - q0)) < 1e-14 and np.max(np.abs(trajectory.Evaluate(1.5)[0] - q2)) < 1e-14]
checks += [np.max(np.abs(v[1:-1] - (q[2:] - q[:-2])/(times[2] - times[0]))) < 1e-2] #the central difference at a jump of the acceleration: 1/4 of it times the step
checks += [max(abs(trajectory.Evaluate(t)[1][0] - 0.8) for t in [0.5, 0.6, 0.75, 0.9, 1.]) < 1e-14] #joint 0 moves on at 0.8 rad/s
checks += [max(np.max(np.abs(trajectory.Evaluate(t, enableBlending=False)[0] - unblended.Evaluate(t)[0])) for t in times[::50]) == 0]
checks += [max(abs(trajectory.EvaluateCoordinate(t, 1)[0] - trajectory.Evaluate(t)[0][1]) for t in times[::50]) < 1e-14]

blendings = trajectory.GetBlendings(chain)
blending = blendings[0]
checks += [len(blendings) == 1 and blending['profile'] == 0 and blending['startTime'] == 0.5 and blending['endTime'] == 1.]
checks += [abs(blending['startDistance'] - 0.25) < 1e-12 and blending['minDistance'] < blending['startDistance']
           and blending['toolMinDistance'] < blending['toolStartDistance']]
exu.Print('blending:', blending['startDistance'], blending['minDistance'], blending['toolStartDistance'], blending['toolMinDistance'])

#a Cartesian line blended with the joint motion back
HT = chain.ToolHT(q0)
cartesian = Trajectory(q0)
cartesian.Add(ProfileCartesianLinear(robot, exu.HT(rotation=HT.rotation, translation=np.array(HT.translation) + [0, 0.2, 0]), 1.), blendTimeWithNext=0.3)
cartesian.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q0, 1.))
qEnd = cartesian.Evaluate(cartesian.GetTimes()[-1])[0]
checks += [np.max(np.abs(qEnd - q0)) < 1e-12 and np.allclose(cartesian.GetTimes(), [0, 1, 1.7])]

#a blend time longer than the next profile is refused
try:
    refused = Trajectory(q0)
    refused.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q1, 2.), blendTimeWithNext=1.5)
    refused.Add(ProfileConstantAcceleration(q2, 1.))
    checks += [False]
except ValueError:
    checks += [True]

u = sum(checks) + blending['startDistance'] + blending['minDistance'] + blending['toolStartDistance'] + blending['toolMinDistance']
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of trajectoryBlendingTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
